repos_data.description: Orchestration of autonomous, collaborative AI agents in Go — an idiomatic Go port of CrewAI.

Open-source AI agent orchestration platform — self-hosted mission control for autonomous multi-agent systems. Visual DAG workflows, 450+ MCP tools, human-in-the-loop approvals. Works with Claude, GPT-4o, Gemini, Ollama, Codex.

Lightweight AI agent runtime for Go. Define multi-agent crews in YAML, run them with goroutines and channels, and let the runtime handle scheduling, parallelism, retries, and observability — without leaving the Go ecosystem.
Build, run and scale AI agents like API and microservices
BenchClaw adapters for LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, Ollama Open WebUI, LobeChat, n8n, Dify, Continue.dev and more. Lets any agent framework submit to the P2PCLAW leaderboard.
Integrate cutting-edge LLM technology quickly and easily into your apps
Shared, versioned memory for AI coding agents — MCP server with git-style history (log/diff/blame) for Claude Code, Cursor & Claude Desktop
Debug, evaluate, and monitor your LLM applications, RAG systems, and agentic workflows with comprehensive tracing, automated evaluations, and production-ready dashboards.

Agent-MCP is a framework for creating multi-agent systems that enables coordinated, efficient AI collaboration through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The system is designed for developers building AI applications that benefit from multiple specialized agents working in parallel on different aspects of a project.
Traffic light for AI Agents and TypeScript/Node multi-agent orchestrator with shared state, guardrails, and adapters for 32 AI frameworks
Connect any AI model to 1200+ integrations (MCP, CLI, API)

repo_meta_data.description: Framework for orchestrating role-playing, autonomous AI agents. By fostering collaborative intelligence, CrewAI empowers agents to work together seamlessly, tackling complex tasks.
